title: AtomEvent
description: Materialized event row for event-anchored atom history. chainHash is deterministic SHA-256 (TODO: will be replaced with cryptographic anchor). prevHash links to the previous event's chainHash for the same (entityType, entityId) pair, forming a tamper-evident chain.

entityId.description: Unique identifier for the atom instance.

actor.description: Identity of the actor that produced this event.

kind.description: Actor type: user (human), agent (AI/bot), or system (automated).

payload.description: Mutation payload as recorded by the atom; stored verbatim as JSONB.

prevHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the previous event in the chain, or null for the first event.

chainHash.description: Deterministic SHA-256 hash of this event. Forms a tamper-evident chain with prevHash.

occurredAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the event occurred (business time).

recordedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the event was recorded in the system.
